```python
"""
FFmpeg utility functions for video processing.

Functions:
- extract_frame: Extract a high-quality frame from a video at a specified time.
- get_video_duration: Get the duration of a video using ffprobe.
- create_gif_from_video: Create a GIF from a video by extracting frames at regular intervals.
"""

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def extract_frame(video_path: Path, time_sec: float, output_img: Path):
    """
    Extract a high-quality frame from a video at a specified time.
    Arguments:
        video_path (Path): The path to the input video file.
        time_sec (float): The time in seconds to extract the frame.
        output_img (Path): The path to save the extracted image.
    """
    # Extract high quality frame
    subprocess.run(
        [
            "ffmpeg",
            "-y",
            "-ss",
            str(time_sec),
            "-i",
            video_path,
            "-frames:v",
            "1",
            "-q:v",
            "2",
            "-vf",
            "scale=1024:-1",  # Qwen likes higher res
            output_img,
        ],
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    )


def get_video_duration(video_path: Path) -> float:
    """
    Get the duration of a video using ffprobe.
    Arguments:
        video_path (Path): The path to the input video file.
    Returns:
        float: The duration of the video in seconds.
    """
    # Get video duration using ffprobe
    result = subprocess.run(
        [
            "ffprobe",
            "-v",
            "error",
            "-show_entries",
            "format=duration",
            "-of",
            "default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1",
            video_path,
        ],
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
    )
    return float(result.stdout.strip()) if result.returncode == 0 else 0.0


def create_gif_from_video(
    video_path: Path, interval_sec: int = 30, output_gif: Path = Path("output.gif")
):
    """
    Create a GIF from a video by extracting frames at regular intervals.
    Arguments:
        video_path (Path): The path to the input video file.
        interval_sec (int): The interval in seconds between frames to extract.
        output_gif (Path): The path to save the output GIF file.
    """
    subprocess.run(
        [
            "ffmpeg",
            "-y",
            "-i",
            video_path,
            "-vf",
            f"fps=1/{interval_sec},scale=320:-1:flags=lanczos",
            "-gifflags",
            "+transdiff",
            "-y",
            output_gif,
        ],
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    )


def extract_audio_track_from_video(
    video_path: Path, output_audio_path: Path, audio_format: str = "wav"
) -> None:
    """
    Extract the audio track from a video file and save it as a separate audio file.
    Arguments:
        video_path (Path): The path to the input video file.
        output_audio_path (Path): The path to save the extracted audio file.
        audio_format (str): The desired audio format (default is "wav").
    """
    import subprocess

    command = [
        "ffmpeg",
        "-i",
        str(video_path),
        "-vn",
        "-acodec",
        "pcm_s16le" if audio_format == "wav" else "copy",
        str(output_audio_path),
    ]
    subprocess.run(command, check=True)

```

```python
"""
Utility functions for file operations.

Functions:
- get_file_sha256: Calculate the SHA256 hash of a file.
- get_file_stat_model: Get the appropriate file stat model based on the OS.
- get_path_model: Get the PathModel for a given file path.
- get_mime_type: Get the MIME type of a file based on its extension.
- extract_audio_track_from_video: Extract the audio track from a video file.
- BaseFileModel_from_Path: Create a BaseFileModel instance from a given file path.
- ImageFileModel_from_Path: Create an ImageFileModel instance from a given file path.
- VideoFileModel_from_Path: Create a VideoFileModel instance from a given file path.
- SqliteFileModel_from_Path: Create a SQLiteFileModel instance from a given file path.
- AudioFileModel_from_Path: Create an AudioFileModel instance from a given file path. (Not yet implemented)
"""

import sys
from os import stat
from pathlib import Path

from core.models.file_system.base import (
    WindowsFileStat,
)
from core.models.file_system.base import BaseFileStat, MacOSFileStat
from core.models.file_system.image_file import ImageFile
from core.models.file_system.video_file import VideoFile
from core.models.file_system.sqlite_file import SQLiteFile
from core.models.file_system.audio_file import AudioFile


def get_file_sha256(file_path: Path) -> str:
    """
    Calculate the SHA256 hash of a file.

    Arguments:
        file_path (Path): The file path to calculate the hash for.

    Returns:
        str: The SHA256 hash as a hexadecimal string.

    Raises:
        RuntimeError: If there is an error reading the file.

    Example:
        >>> sha256 = get_file_sha256(Path("document.txt"))
        >>> print(sha256)
        '3a7bd3e2360a3d80c4f1b...'
    """
    import hashlib

    sha256_hash = hashlib.sha256()
    try:
        with file_path.open("rb") as f:
            for byte_block in iter(lambda: f.read(4096), b""):
                sha256_hash.update(byte_block)
        return sha256_hash.hexdigest()
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Error calculating SHA256 for file {file_path}: {e}") from e


def get_file_stat_model(file_path: Path) -> "BaseFileStat":  # type: ignore # noqa: F821
    """
    Get the appropriate file stat model based on the operating system.

    Arguments:
        file_path (Path): The file path to get stats for.

    Returns:
        BaseFileStatModel: The corresponding file stat model instance.

    Example:
        >>> stat_model = get_file_stat_model(Path("/home/user/document.txt"))
        >>> print(stat_model)
        LinuxFileStatModel(...)
    """
    from core.models.file_system.base import (
        LinuxFileStat,
    )

    file_stat = stat(file_path)

    system = sys.platform
    if system == "Darwin":
        return MacOSFileStat.model_validate(
            {
                stat_key: getattr(file_stat, stat_key)
                for stat_key in dir(file_stat)
                if not stat_key.startswith("_")
            }
        )
    elif system == "Windows":
        return WindowsFileStat.model_validate(
            {
                stat_key: getattr(file_stat, stat_key)
                for stat_key in dir(file_stat)
                if not stat_key.startswith("_")
            }
        )
    elif system == "Linux":
        return LinuxFileStat.model_validate(
            {
                stat_key: getattr(file_stat, stat_key)
                for stat_key in dir(file_stat)
                if not stat_key.startswith("_")
            }
        )
    else:
        return BaseFileStat.model_validate(
            {
                stat_key: getattr(file_stat, stat_key)
                for stat_key in dir(file_stat)
                if not stat_key.startswith("_")
            }
        )


def get_path_model(file_path: Path) -> "PathModel":  # type: ignore  # noqa: F821
    """
    Get the PathModel for a given file path.

    Arguments:
        file_path (Path): The file path to model.
    Returns:
        PathModel: The corresponding PathModel instance.

    Example:
        >>> path_model = get_path_model(Path("/home/user/document.txt"))
        >>> print(path_model)
        PathModel(...)
    """
    from core.models.file_system.base import FilePath

    return FilePath(
        name=file_path.name,
        suffix=file_path.suffix,
        suffixes=file_path.suffixes,
        stem=file_path.stem,
        parent=str(file_path.parent),
        parents=[str(p) for p in file_path.parents],
        anchor=file_path.anchor,
        drive=file_path.drive,
        root=file_path.root,
        parts=[p for p in file_path.parts],
        is_absolute=file_path.is_absolute(),
    )


def get_mime_type(file_path: Path) -> str | None:
    """
    Get the MIME type of a file based on its extension.

    Arguments:
        file_path (Path): The file path to get the MIME type for.

    Returns:
        str | None: The MIME type if found, otherwise None.

    Example:
        >>> get_mime_type(Path("document.txt"))
        'text/plain'
        >>> get_mime_type(Path("image.jpg"))
        'image/jpeg'
    """
    import mimetypes

    mime_type, _ = mimetypes.guess_type(file_path.as_posix())
    return mime_type


def BaseFileModel_from_Path(file_path: Path) -> "BaseFileModel":  # type: ignore  # noqa: F821
    """
    Create a BaseFileModel instance from a given file path.

    Args:
        file_path (Path): The path to the file.

    Returns:
        BaseFileModel: An instance of BaseFileModel populated with data from the file.

    Raises:
        RuntimeError: If there is an error creating the BaseFileModel.

    Example:
        >>> file_model = BaseFileModel_from_Path(Path("document.txt"))
        >>> print(file_model)
        BaseFileModel(...)
    """
    from core.models.file_system.base import BaseFileModel

    try:
        file_model = BaseFileModel(
            sha256=get_file_sha256(file_path),
            stat_json=get_file_stat_model(file_path),
            path_json=get_path_model(file_path),
            mime_type=get_mime_type(file_path),
            tags=[],  # Initialize with empty tags list
            short_description=None,  # Set default to None
            long_description=None,  # Set default to None
            frozen=False,  # Set default to False
        )
        file_model.populate(file_path)
        return file_model
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Error creating BaseFileModel from path {file_path}: {e}"
        ) from e


def ImageFileModel_from_Path(file_path: Path) -> "ImageFile":  # type: ignore  # noqa: F821
    """
    Create an ImageFileModel instance from a given file path.

    Args:
        file_path (Path): The path to the image file.

    Returns:
        Optional[ImageFileModel]: An instance of ImageFileModel populated with data from the file.

    Raises:
        RuntimeError: If there is an error creating the ImageFileModel.

    Example:
        >>> img_model = ImageFileModel_from_Path(Path("photo.jpg"))
        >>> print(img_model)
        ImageFileModel(...)
    """
    from core.models.file_system.image_file import ImageFile

    try:
        _base = BaseFileModel_from_Path(file_path)
        img_model = ImageFile.model_validate(_base.model_dump())
        img_model.populate(file_path)
        return img_model
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(

        ) from e

def SqliteFileModel_from_Path(file_path: Path) -> "SQLiteFile":  # type: ignore  # noqa: F821
    """
    Create a SQLiteFileModel instance from a given file path.

    Args:
        file_path (Path): The path to the SQLite database file.

    Returns:
        SQLiteFileModel: An instance of SQLiteFileModel populated with data from the file.

    Raises:
        RuntimeError: If there is an error creating the SQLiteFileModel.

    Example:
        >>> sqlite_model = SqliteFileModel_from_Path(Path("database.sqlite"))
        >>> print(sqlite_model)

        sqlite_model = SQLiteFile.model_validate(_base.model_dump())
        sqlite_model.populate(file_path)
        return sqlite_model
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Error creating SQLiteFileModel from path {file_path}: {e}"
        ) from e


def AudioFileModel_from_Path(file_path: Path) -> "AudioFile":  # type: ignore  # noqa: F821
    """
```

```python
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

import git

from core.models.repo import GitCommit
from core.models.repo import GitMetadata


def get_git_metadata(repo_path: Path) -> GitMetadata | None:
    """Extract git metadata from repository."""
    if not (repo_path / ".git").exists() or not repo_path.is_dir():
        return None
    try:
        repo = git.Repo(repo_path)

        # Get remotes
        remotes = {remote.name: remote.url for remote in repo.remotes}

        # Get current branch
        try:
            current_branch = repo.active_branch.name
        except TypeError:
            current_branch = "HEAD (detached)"

        # Get all branches
        branches = [branch.name for branch in repo.branches]

        # Get commit info
        try:
            latest_commit = repo.head.commit
            commit_info = GitCommit(
                hash=latest_commit.hexsha[:8],
                message=latest_commit.message.strip(),
                author=str(latest_commit.author),
                date=latest_commit.committed_datetime.isoformat(),
            )
        except Exception:
            commit_info = {"error": "Unable to get commit info"}

        # Check for uncommitted changes
        is_dirty = repo.is_dirty()
        untracked_files = len(repo.untracked_files)

        return GitMetadata(
            remotes=remotes,
            current_branch=current_branch,
            branches=branches,
            latest_commit=commit_info,
            uncommitted_changes=is_dirty,
            untracked_files=untracked_files,
            commit_history=get_all_commits(repo_path, max_count=10) or [],
        )
    except Exception as e:
        return None


def get_latest_commit(repo_path: Path) -> GitCommit | None:
    """Get the latest commit information from the git repository."""
    if not (repo_path / ".git").exists() or not repo_path.is_dir():
        return None
    try:
        repo = git.Repo(repo_path)
        latest_commit = repo.head.commit
        return GitCommit(
            hash=latest_commit.hexsha[:8],
            message=latest_commit.message.strip(),
            author=str(latest_commit.author),
            date=latest_commit.committed_datetime.isoformat(),
        )
    except Exception:
        return None


def get_all_commits(repo_path: Path, max_count: int = 10) -> list[GitCommit] | None:
    """Get a list of commits from the git repository."""
    if not (repo_path / ".git").exists() or not repo_path.is_dir():
        return None
    try:
        repo = git.Repo(repo_path)
        commits = []
        for commit in repo.iter_commits(max_count=max_count):
            commits.append(
                GitCommit(
                    hash=commit.hexsha[:8],
                    message=commit.message.strip(),
                    author=str(commit.author),
                    date=commit.committed_datetime.isoformat(),
                )
            )
        return commits
    except Exception:
        return None


def get_repo_name(repo_path: Path) -> str | None:
    """Get the repository name from the git repository."""
    if not (repo_path / ".git").exists() or not repo_path.is_dir():
        return None
    try:
        repo = git.Repo(repo_path)
        return repo.working_tree_dir.split("/")[-1]
    except Exception:
        return None


def clone_repository(
    repo_url: str, clone_path: Optional[Path] = None, branch: Optional[str] = None
) -> Path:
    """Clone a git repository to the specified or temporary path.
    Args:
        repo_url: The URL of the git repository to clone.
        clone_path: The local path to clone the repository into. If None, a temporary directory is used.
        branch: (Optional) The branch to clone. If None, the default branch is used.
    Raises:
        Exception: If cloning fails.
    Returns:
        Path: The path to the cloned repository.
    """
    try:
        if clone_path is None:
            import tempfile

            clone_path = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
        if branch:
            git.Repo.clone_from(repo_url, clone_path, branch=branch)
        else:
            git.Repo.clone_from(repo_url, clone_path)
        return clone_path
    except Exception as e:
        raise Exception(f"Failed to clone repository: {e}")
```

```python
import re
import string
from typing import Generator


class TextStreamBuffer:
    """
    Accumulates text chunks and yields complete sentences.
    Essential for streaming TTS where prosody depends on sentence context.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.buffer = ""
        # Match sentence endings (. ! ?) followed by whitespace or EOS
        # We use a lookbehind to keep the punctuation with the sentence.
        self._sentence_split_regex = re.compile(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+")

    def add_part(self, chunk: str) -> Generator[str, None, None]:
        self.buffer += chunk

        # If we have a sentence ending in the buffer...
        if self._sentence_split_regex.search(self.buffer):
            sentences = self._sentence_split_regex.split(self.buffer)

            # The last part is likely incomplete (e.g. "Hello world. How a")
            # So we yield everything except the last part, and keep the last part in buffer.
            # UNLESS the buffer ends exactly with a split char (handled by regex split usually returning empty string at end if match is at end)

            if len(sentences) > 1:
                # We have at least one complete sentence
                for sentence in sentences[:-1]:
                    if sentence.strip():
                        yield sentence.strip()

                # Keep the remainder
                self.buffer = sentences[-1]

    def flush(self) -> Generator[str, None, None]:
        """Yields whatever is left in the buffer."""
        if self.buffer.strip():
            yield self.buffer.strip()
        self.buffer = ""


def remove_punctuation(text: str) -> str:
    """
    Removes all punctuation from the given text string.

    Args:
        text (str): The input string.

    Returns:
        str: The string with punctuation removed.
    """
    if not text:
        return ""
    return text.translate(str.maketrans("", "", string.punctuation))


def pascal_to_lower_snake(name: str) -> str:
    """Converts a PascalCase string to lower_snake_case."""
    return "_".join(word.lower() for word in re.findall(r"[A-Z][a-z]*", name))


def safe_snake_slug_url(name: str) -> str:
    """Converts a website url to filename safe snake_case string
    removing the http:// or https:// prefix and returning a
    sluggified string of the base-url and any sub-urls
    omitting any port numbers, query parameters, and large
    path parameters: e.g. https://www.google.com/dsd4fw432..<some 64 character id>../content/<some other large id>../
    would become `www_google_com_[param]_content_[param]` literally replacing the large ids with the string `[param]`
    """
    query_params = ""
    # if there are query parameters, extract them and replace the query string with `[params|key=value|key=value|...]` format
    if "?" in name:
        query_params = name.split("?")[1]
        name = name.split("?")[0]
    # remove http:// or https:// prefix
    name = re.sub(r"^https?://", "", name)
    # remove any hashes or strings that are likely some id (md5, sha1, sha256, etc) replacing with `[path_param_match|md5]` or `[path_param_match|sha1]` or `[path_param_match|sha256]` etc

    # match md5
    name = re.sub(r"[a-fA-F0-9]{32}", "[path_param_match|md5]", name)
    # match sha1
    name = re.sub(r"[a-fA-F0-9]{40}", "[path_param_match|sha1]", name)
    # match sha256
    name = re.sub(r"[a-fA-F0-9]{64}", "[path_param_match|sha256]", name)
    # match sha512
    name = re.sub(r"[a-fA-F0-9]{128}", "[path_param_match|sha512]", name)
    # match number strands larger than a 16bit integer can hold
    name = re.sub(r"\b\d{5,}\b", "[path_param_match|int]", name)
    # so we will replace parse out the QUERY parameters and tack them to the end using `[params|key=value|key=value|...]` format
    if query_params:
        query_params = "|".join(query_params.split("&"))
        name = f"{name}|[params|{query_params}]"
    return name
```

```python
"""
Module for managing a repository clone index.
This module provides functionality to manage a repository clone index, including adding, removing,
and listing cloned repositories. It also supports cloning repositories from remote URLs
and syncing them with their remote counterparts.

Attributes:
    _clone_root (Path): The root directory for cloned repositories.

Classes:
    RepoIndexEntry: Model representing an entry in the repository clone index.
    RepoSyncResult: Model representing the result of a repository sync operation.
    RepoManagerService: Handler for managing the repository clone index.

"""

import json
import tarfile
import shutil
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional, Callable

import git
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_serializer, field_validator

from core.config import settings
from core.utils import get_time


# logger will log to logs/services/clone.log|clone.json LEVEL: INFO
# log only to json file. messages will be returned from methods for things like HTTP responses or as a tuple[str, Any] if there are results to return
# TODO: implement logging after TODOs in core.logging are completed

# logger = core.logging.get_json_only_logger("CloneService") # TODO: Update the TODOs in core.logging to impliment a json only logger getter.
# All logging will be mocked as though this logger exists. uncomment when done.

### NOTE: IF EDITING THIS FILE BEFORE TODOS HAVE BEEN COMPLETED, ALL COMMENTS **MUST** REMAIN IN THIS FILE **AS THEY ARE**.


_clone_root: Path = Path(settings.remotes_dir)
_clone_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


class RepoIndexEntry(BaseModel):
    """
    Model representing an entry in the repository clone index.
    Attributes:
        cloned_at (datetime): The timestamp when the repository was cloned.
        is_temporary (bool): Whether the cloned repository is temporary.
        repo_dir (Path): The directory of the cloned repository.
    Methods:
        exists (bool): Whether the repository directory exists.
    """

    cloned_at: datetime = Field(
        default_factory=get_time(),
        description="The timestamp when the repository was cloned.",
    )
    is_temporary: bool = Field(
        default=False, description="Whether the cloned repository is temporary."
    )
    repo_dir: Path = Field(..., description="The directory of the cloned repository.")

    @field_serializer("repo_dir", return_type=str, when_used="json")
    def serialize_repo_dir(self, repo_dir: str) -> str:
        """
        Serialize the repository directory to a string.
        Args:
            repo_dir (str): The directory of the cloned repository.
        Returns:
            str: The string representation of the repository directory.
        """
        return repo_dir.as_posix()

    @field_serializer("cloned_at", return_type=str, when_used="json")
    def serialize_cloned_at(self, cloned_at: str) -> str:
        """
        Serialize the cloned_at timestamp to a string.
        Args:
            cloned_at (str): The timestamp when the repository was cloned.
        Returns:
            str: The string representation of the cloned_at timestamp.
        """
        return cloned_at.isoformat()

    @field_validator("cloned_at", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def validate_cloned_at(cls, v: str) -> datetime:
        """
        Validate the cloned_at timestamp.
        Args:
            v (str): The timestamp when the repository was cloned.
        Returns:
            datetime: The validated cloned_at timestamp.
        """
        return datetime.fromisoformat(v)

    @field_validator("repo_dir", mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def validate_repo_dir(cls, v: str) -> Path:
        """
        Validate the repository directory.
        Args:
            v (str): The repository directory to validate.
        Returns:
            Path: The validated repository directory.
        """
        return Path(v)

    def exists(self) -> bool:
        """
        Check if the repository directory exists.
        Returns:
            bool: True if the repository directory exists, False otherwise.
        """
        return Path(self.repo_dir).exists() if self.repo_dir else False


class RepoSyncResult(BaseModel):
    """
    Model representing the result of a repository sync operation.
    """

    successes: list[RepoIndexEntry] = Field(
        ..., description="list of successfully synced repositories."
    )
    errors: list[RepoIndexEntry] = Field(
        ..., description="list of repositories that failed to sync."
    )


class RepoManagerService:
    """
    Handler for managing the repository clone index.

    Attributes:
        _file (Path): The path to the index file.
        _index (list[RepoIndexEntry]): The index of cloned repositories.
        _clone_root (Path): The default root directory for cloned repositories.
    Methods:
        __init__ (self): Initialize the index handler.
        _init_index (self): Initialize the index file.
        _load_index (self): Load the index from the index file.
        _save_index (self): Save the index to the index file.
        add (self, repo_url: str, is_temporary: bool = False, clone_path: Optional[Path] = None): Add a repository to the index.
        remove (self, repo_url: str): Remove a repository from the index.
        index (dict[str, RepoIndexEntry]): The index of cloned repositories.
        file (Path): The path to the index file.
        clone_root (Path): The default root directory for cloned repositories.
        clone (self, repo_url: str, branch: Optional[str] = None, is_temporary: bool = False) -> Path: Clone a git repository to the specified or temporary path.
    """

    _file: Path = _clone_root / "_REPOS"
    _index: list[RepoIndexEntry] = []
    _clone_root: Path = _clone_root

    def __init__(self):
        """
        Initialize the index handler.
        """
        self._init_index()
        self._load_index()

    def _repopulate_index(self):
        """
        Re-populate the index from the clone root directory.
        USE ONLY WHEN REBUILDING THE INDEX FROM DISK OR IF THE INDEX IS CORRUPTED.

        Raises:
            Exception: If the index cannot be populated.

        Returns:
            None
        """
        self._index = []
        for repo_path in self._clone_root.iterdir():
            if (repo_path / ".git").exists():
                try:
                    self._index.append(
                        RepoIndexEntry(
                            cloned_at=get_time(),
                            is_temporary=False,
                            repo_dir=repo_path,
                        )
                    )
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    continue
                except Exception:
                    # logger.exception("Failed to populate index from disk")
                    print("Failed to populate index from disk")  # to appease mypy
                    raise
        self._save_index()

    def _init_index(self):
        """
        Initialize the index file.
        """
        self._file.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with open(self._file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump({}, f)

    def _load_index(self):
        try:
            if self._file.exists():
                with open(self._file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    self._index = [
                        RepoIndexEntry.model_validate(entry) for entry in json.load(f)
                    ]
        except FileNotFoundError:
            self._repopulate_index()
        except Exception:
            # logger.error("Failed to load index file: %s", self._file)
            # logger.exception("Failed to load index file: %s", self._file, exc_info=True)
            print(f"Failed to load index file: {self._file}")  #  to appease mypy
            raise
        return self._index

    def _save_index(self):
        with open(self._file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump([entry.model_dump() for entry in self._index], f)

    def add(
        self,
        repo_url: str,
        is_temporary: bool = False,
        clone_path: Optional[Path] = None,
    ):
        """
        Add a repository to the index.
        Args:
            repo_url (str): The URL of the repository to add.
            is_temporary (bool): Whether the repository is temporary.
            clone_path (Optional[Path]): The path to the cloned repository.
        Returns:
            str: A message indicating that the repository was added to the index.
        """
        self._index.append(
            RepoIndexEntry(
                cloned_at=get_time(),
                is_temporary=is_temporary,
                repo_dir=clone_path,
            )
        )
        self._save_index()
        return f"added {repo_url} to index"

    def remove(self, repo_url: str):
        """
        Remove a repository from the index.

        Args:
            repo_url (str): The URL of the repository to remove.

        Returns:
            str: A message indicating that the repository was removed from the index.

        Example:
            >>> from src.services.repo_manager_service import RepoManagerService
            >>> repo_manager = RepoManagerService()
            >>> repo_manager.remove("https://github.com/user/repo.git")
            >>>
            >>> Removed https://github.com/user/repo.git from index
        """
        if any(entry.repo_url == repo_url for entry in self._index):
            self._index = [entry for entry in self._index if entry.repo_url != repo_url]
            self._save_index()
            return f"removed {repo_url} from index"
        return f"{repo_url} not found in index"

    def update(self):
        """
        Public method to save the current index to the index file.

        Returns:
            None

        Example:
            >>> from src.services.repo_manager_service import RepoManagerService
            >>> repo_manager = RepoManagerService()
            >>> repo_manager.update()
            >>>
            >>> Index updated successfully
        """
        self._save_index()

    def clean_temp_repos(self) -> None:
        """
        Remove all temporary repositories from the index and delete their directories.

        Example:
            >>> from src.services.repo_manager_service import RepoManagerService
            >>> repo_manager = RepoManagerService()
            >>> repo_manager.clean_temp_repos()
            >>>
            >>> Removed temporary repository: /Remotes/devtul
            >>> Removed temporary repository: /Remotes/another_temp_repo
            >>> ... etc ...
        """
        for entry in self._index.index:
            if entry.is_temporary:
                try:
                    shutil.rmtree(entry.repo_dir)
                    print(f"Removed temporary repository: {entry.repo_dir}")
                    # logger.info(f"Removed temporary repository: {entry.repo_dir}")
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"Failed to remove temporary repository: {e}")
                    # logger.error(f"Failed to remove temporary repository: {e}")
                    raise
        self._index.index = [
            entry for entry in self._index.index if not entry.is_temporary
        ]
        self._index.update()

    def export_repos(self) -> Path:
        """
        Export all cloned repositories as tar.gz files in the 'exports' directory.

        Raises:
            Exception: If exporting a repository fails.

        Example:
            >>> from src.services.repo_manager_service import RepoManagerService
            >>> repo_manager = RepoManagerService()
            >>> export_path = repo_manager.export_repos()
            >>> print(f"Repositories exported to: {export_path}")
            >>>
            >>> Repositories exported to: /Remotes/exports
        """
        export_path = self._clone_root / "exports"
        export_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for entry in self._index.index:
            try:
                with tarfile.open(
                    f"{export_path / entry.repo_dir.name}.tar.gz", "w:gz"
                ) as tar:
                    tar.add(entry.repo_dir, arcname=entry.repo_dir.name)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Failed to export repository: {e}")
                raise
        return export_path

    def clone(
        self, repo_url: str, branch: Optional[str] = None, is_temporary: bool = False
    ) -> Path:
        """Clone a git repository to the specified or temporary path.

        Args:
            repo_url (str): The URL of the git repository to clone.
            branch (Optional[str]): The branch to clone. If None, the default branch is used.

        Raises:
            Exception: If cloning fails.

        Returns:
            Path: The path to the cloned repository.

        Example:
            >>> from src.services.repo_manager_service import RepoManagerService
            >>> repo_manager = RepoManagerService()
            >>> clone_path = repo_manager.clone(
            ...     repo_url="https://Github.com/Willmo103/devtul.git",
            ...     branch="main",
            ...     is_temporary=False
            )
            print(f"Repository cloned to: {clone_path}")
            # Output: Repository cloned to: /Remotes/devtul
        """
        _clone_path = self._clone_root / repo_url.split("/")[-1]
        try:
            if branch:
                git.Repo.clone_from(repo_url, _clone_path, branch=branch)
            else:
                git.Repo.clone_from(repo_url, _clone_path)
            try:
                self._index.add(
                    repo_url,
                    is_temporary=is_temporary,
                    clone_path=_clone_path,
                )
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Failed to add repository to index: {e}")
                # logger.error(f"Failed to add repository to index: {e}")
                raise
            return _clone_path
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Failed to clone repository: {e}")
            # logger.error(f"Failed to clone repository: {e}")
            raise

    def sync_repos(
        self, callback: Optional[Callable[[RepoSyncResult], None]] = None
    ) -> None:
        """
        Sync all cloned repositories with their remote repositories.

        Args:
            callback (Optional[Callable[Any]]): A callback function to be called after each repository is synced.

        Returns:
            None

        Example:
            >>> from src.services.repo_manager_service import RepoManagerService
            >>> repo_manager = RepoManagerService()
            >>> repo_manager.sync_repos()
        """
        successes, errors = [], []
        for entry in self._index:
            try:
                repo = git.Repo(entry.repo_dir)
                repo.remotes.origin.fetch()
                repo.remotes.origin.pull()
                successes.append(entry)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Failed to sync repository: {e}")
                # logger.error(f"Failed to sync repository: {e}")
                errors.append(entry)
            if callback:
                callback(RepoSyncResult(successes=successes, errors=errors))
        return

    @property
    def entries(self):
        """
        Returns the list of `RepoIndexEntry` objects representing the index of cloned repositories.

        Returns:
            list[RepoIndexEntry]: The index of cloned repositories.

        Example:
            >>> from src.services.repo_manager_service import RepoManagerService
            >>> repo_manager = RepoManagerService()
            >>> index = repo_manager.entries
            >>> for entry in index:
            ...     print(entry.repo_dir.model_dump_json(indent=4))

            # {
            #     "cloned_at": "2024-06-01T12:00:00",
            #     "is_temporary": false,
            #     "repo_dir": "/path/to/cloned/repo"
            # }
        """
        return self._index

    @property
    def file(self):
        """
        Get the path to the index file.

        Returns:
            Path: The path to the index file.

        Example:
            >>> from src.services.repo_manager_service import RepoManagerService
            >>> repo_manager = RepoManagerService()
            >>> index_file = repo_manager.file
            >>> print(f"Index file path: {index_file}")
            >>>
            >>> Index file path: /Remotes/_REPOS
        """
        return Path(self._file)

    @property
    def default_clone_root(self) -> Path:
        """
        Get the default root directory for cloned repositories.

        Returns:
            Path: The default root directory for cloned repositories.

        Example:
            >>> from src.services.repo_manager_service import RepoManagerService
            >>> repo_manager = RepoManagerService()
            >>> clone_root = repo_manager.default_clone_root
            >>> print(f"Default clone root: {clone_root}")

            >>> Default clone root: /Remotes
        """
        return Path(self._clone_root)
```

```python
import os

import numpy as np
import torch
from faster_whisper import WhisperModel

from core.logging_ import service_logger


logger = service_logger.getChild("stt_engine")


class STTEngine:
    def __init__(self):
        self.model_size = os.getenv("STT_MODEL", "base.en")
        self.device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
        self.compute_type = "float16" if self.device == "cuda" else "int8"

        logger.info(
            f"Loading Faster-Whisper model: {self.model_size} on {self.device} ({self.compute_type})"
        )
        self.model = WhisperModel(
            self.model_size, device=self.device, compute_type=self.compute_type
        )

        # Load Silero VAD for detection mode
        self.vad_model, utils = torch.hub.load(
            repo_or_dir="snakers4/silero-vad",
            model="silero_vad",
            force_reload=False,
            trust_repo=True,
        )
        (self.get_speech_timestamps, _, _, _, _) = utils
        logger.info("STT Engine Ready.")

    def transcribe_file(self, file_path: str, beam_size: int = 5):
        """Transcribes a full audio file."""
        segments, info = self.model.transcribe(file_path, beam_size=beam_size)

        text = "".join([segment.text for segment in segments])
        return {
            "text": text.strip(),
            "language": info.language,
            "probability": info.language_probability,
            "duration": info.duration,
        }

    def transcribe_waveform(self, audio_data: np.ndarray, sample_rate: int = 16000):
        """
        Transcribes raw numpy audio data.
        Used for streaming/buffered chunks.
        """
        # faster-whisper expects a float32 array
        segments, info = self.model.transcribe(
            audio_data, beam_size=5, language="en"  # Force English for speed if needed
        )
        text = "".join([segment.text for segment in segments])
        return text.strip()

    def detect_voice(self, audio_chunk: np.ndarray, sample_rate: int = 16000) -> bool:
        """
        Fast VAD check. Returns True if speech is present in the chunk.
        """
        # Convert to tensor for Silero
        tensor = torch.from_numpy(audio_chunk)

        # Silero expects float32, normalized -1 to 1
        speech_timestamps = self.get_speech_timestamps(
            tensor, self.vad_model, sampling_rate=sample_rate
        )
        return len(speech_timestamps) > 0

    def is_ready(self) -> bool:
        """Check if the engine is ready."""
        return self.model is not None
```

```python
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from fastapi import FastAPI, File, UploadFile, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

from core.logging_ import service_logger

from .engine import STTEngine


# Initialize
app = FastAPI(title="STT Service", version="1.0.0")
engine = STTEngine()
logger = service_logger.getChild("stt_service")

# CORS
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)


@app.post("/transcribe")
async def transcribe_audio_file(file: UploadFile = File(...)):
    """Upload a file (wav, mp3) to transcribe."""
    # Create a temp file with the correct extension so ffmpeg/whisper knows the format
    suffix = Path(file.filename).suffix

    # delete=False is crucial on Windows to allow re-opening the file by the engine
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=suffix) as tmp:
        shutil.copyfileobj(file.file, tmp)
        temp_path = tmp.name

    try:
        start_time = time.time()
        result = engine.transcribe_file(temp_path)
        process_time = time.time() - start_time
        return {**result, "process_time": process_time}
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"Transcription failed: {e}")
        return {"error": str(e)}
    finally:
        # Cleanup the temp file
        if os.path.exists(temp_path):
            os.remove(temp_path)


@app.websocket("/stream")
async def websocket_endpoint(websocket: WebSocket):
    """
    Real-time audio streaming endpoint.
    Expects raw float32 bytes.
    """
    await websocket.accept()
    logger.info("Client connected to STT Stream")

    try:
        while True:
            # Receive audio bytes (expecting float32 raw pcm)
            data = await websocket.receive_bytes()

            # Convert to numpy array
            audio_array = np.frombuffer(data, dtype=np.float32)

            # 1. VAD Check (Optional, saves compute)
            if engine.detect_voice(audio_array):
                # 2. Transcribe
                text = engine.transcribe_waveform(audio_array)
                if text:
                    await websocket.send_text(text)

    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        logger.info("Client disconnected")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"Stream error: {e}")


@app.get("/health")
async def health_check():
    """Health check endpoint."""
    if engine.is_ready():
        return {"status": "ok"}
    else:
        return {"status": "error", "message": "Engine not ready"}
```

```python
import io
import uuid
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from fastapi import (
    BackgroundTasks,
    FastAPI,
    HTTPException,
    WebSocket,
    WebSocketDisconnect,
)
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

from core.clients.s3_client import s3_client

# Core imports
from core.config import settings
from core.database import async_sessionmaker
from core.logging_ import service_logger
from core.models.tts import TTSHistoryEntity
from tts_service.models import TTSRequest
from core.utils.text import TextStreamBuffer
from tts_service.piper_engine import PiperEngine


logger = service_logger.getChild("Piper-TTS API")

# Global Engine
engine: PiperEngine = None


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    global engine
    try:
        engine = PiperEngine()
        logger.info("TTS Service initialized successfully.")
        yield
    except Exception as e:
        logger.critical(f"Failed to initialize TTS Service: {e}")
        raise


app = FastAPI(title="TTS Service", version="1.0.0", lifespan=lifespan)
s3_tts_bucket = settings.s3.tts_bucket
s3_client.ensure_buckets([s3_tts_bucket])


async def upload_and_log_background(request_id: str, text: str, full_audio: bytes):
    """
    Background task: Uploads the accumulated buffer to S3 and logs to DB.
    This runs AFTER the stream has finished sending to the client.
    """
    try:
        # 1. Upload to S3
        filename = f"{request_id}.wav"
        s3_key = s3_client.upload_bytes(
            full_audio,
            filename,
            bucket=s3_tts_bucket,
            content_type="audio/wav",
        )
        logger.info(f"Background upload complete: {s3_key}")

        # 2. Log to DB
        async with async_sessionmaker() as session:
            entry = TTSHistoryEntity(
                text=text,
                voice=settings.tts.default_model,
                server_url=s3_key,
                # Optionally store raw bytes if small enough, but usually S3 is better
                response_bytes=full_audio if len(full_audio) < 1_000_000 else None,
                bucket_path=s3_key,
            )
            session.add(entry)
            await session.commit()

    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"Background processing failed for {request_id}: {e}")


@app.post("/generate", response_class=StreamingResponse)
async def generate_audio(request: TTSRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks):
    """
    Streams audio bytes immediately.
    Passes advanced synthesis parameters to the engine.
    """
    if not engine:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="TTS Engine not ready")

    request_id = request.request_id or str(uuid.uuid4())
    logger.info(f"Received request {request_id}: {request.text[:30]}...")

    def stream_generator():
        buffer = io.BytesIO()
        try:
            # Pass all config parameters from request to stream()
            stream_iter = engine.stream(
                request.text,
                speaker_id=request.speaker_id,
                length_scale=request.length_scale,
                noise_scale=request.noise_scale,
                noise_w=request.noise_w,
                sentence_silence=request.sentence_silence,
            )

            for chunk in stream_iter:
                buffer.write(chunk)
                yield chunk

            # Streaming done. Hand off to background task.
            full_audio = buffer.getvalue()
            background_tasks.add_task(
                upload_and_log_background, request_id, request.text, full_audio
            )

        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Streaming failed: {e}")
            return

    return StreamingResponse(
        stream_generator(), media_type="audio/wav", headers={"X-Request-ID": request_id}
    )


@app.websocket("/generate/stream")
async def websocket_tts_stream(websocket: WebSocket):
    """
    Bi-directional streaming:
    Input: Text Chunks (from LLM)
    Output: Audio Bytes (WAV Header first, then PCM chunks)
    """
    await websocket.accept()

    # 1. Initialize Buffer
    text_buffer = TextStreamBuffer()

    # 2. Send WAV Header immediately so client prepares playback
    # We generate a dummy header using the engine's default settings
    if engine and engine.voice:
        sample_rate = engine.voice.config.sample_rate
        header = engine._create_wav_header(sample_rate, 2, 1)
        await websocket.send_bytes(header)

    try:
        while True:
            # Receive text chunk from client (e.g., Ollama token)
            data = await websocket.receive_text()

            # Check for specific "End of Stream" signal,
            # otherwise handle disconnects naturally.
            if data == "<EOS>":
                break

            # Process chunk -> Sentences
            for sentence in text_buffer.add_part(data):
                # Generate audio for this sentence (Raw PCM, no header)
                # Note: engine.stream is synchronous, so this blocks the event loop briefly.
                # For high-load, run_in_threadpool is better, but this works for single-user.
                for audio_chunk in engine.stream(sentence, skip_header=True):
                    await websocket.send_bytes(audio_chunk)

        # Flush remaining text (e.g. the last sentence without a period)
        for sentence in text_buffer.flush():
            for audio_chunk in engine.stream(sentence, skip_header=True):
                await websocket.send_bytes(audio_chunk)

    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        logger.info("Client disconnected from TTS stream")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.exception(f"WebSocket error: {e}")
        await websocket.close(code=1011)


@app.get("/health")
def health_check():
    if engine and engine.voice:
        return {"status": "ok", "model": settings.tts.default_model}
    return {"status": "initializing"}
```

```python
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional


import uuid


class TTSRequest(BaseModel):
    """Payload sent to the TTS Service."""

    text: str = Field(..., description="The text to convert to speech.")
    request_id: str = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()), description="Unique ID for tracking."
    )

    # --- Configuration Overrides ---
    model_name: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Specific Piper model to use.")
    speaker_id: Optional[int] = Field(
        None, description="Speaker ID for multi-speaker models."
    )

    # Friendly "Internals" Exposure
    length_scale: float = Field(
        1.0,
        description="Speed of speech. Lower is faster (e.g. 0.75), higher is slower (e.g. 1.25).",
    )
    noise_scale: float = Field(
        0.667, description="Phoneme noise. Controls audio variability/expressiveness."
    )
    noise_w: float = Field(
        0.8, description="Phoneme width noise. Controls randomness in phoneme duration."
    )
    sentence_silence: float = Field(
        0.2, description="Seconds of silence after each sentence."
    )


class TTSResponse(BaseModel):
    """Payload returned by the TTS Service."""

    request_id: str
    success: bool
    file_path: Optional[str] = Field(
        None,
        description="Path to the generated audio file (or URL if using file server).",
    )
    file_uuid: Optional[str] = None
    error_message: Optional[str] = None
    duration_seconds: Optional[float] = None
```

```python
import io
import wave
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Generator

import piper

from core.config import settings
from core.logging_ import service_logger


logger = service_logger.getChild("PiperEngine")


class PiperEngine:
    model_path: Path
    config_path: Path
    voice: piper.PiperVoice

    def __init__(self):
        try:
            if not settings.tts.model_dir.exists():
                model_dir = Path("/tts_models")
                logger.warning(
                    f"Piper models directory {settings.tts.model_dir} does not exist. "
                    f"Falling back to {model_dir}."
                )
            else:
                model_dir = settings.tts.model_dir

            self.model_path = model_dir / f"{settings.tts.default_model}.onnx"
            self.config_path = model_dir / f"{settings.tts.default_model}.onnx.json"

            if not self.model_path.exists():
                raise FileNotFoundError(
                    f"Model not found at {self.model_path}. Run setup_tts.py first."
                )

            self.voice = piper.PiperVoice.load(
                str(self.model_path.as_posix()),
                config_path=str(self.config_path.as_posix()),
            )
            logger.info(
                f"Loaded Piper model '{settings.tts.default_model}' from {self.model_path}"
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Error initializing PiperEngine: {e}")
            raise

    def _get_config(self, speaker_id: int = None, **kwargs) -> piper.SynthesisConfig:
        """Helper to build the SynthesisConfig object with defaults."""
        return piper.SynthesisConfig(
            speaker_id=speaker_id,
            length_scale=kwargs.get("length_scale", 1.0),
            noise_scale=kwargs.get("noise_scale", 0.667),
            noise_w_scale=kwargs.get("noise_w", 0.8),
            normalize_audio=True,
            volume=kwargs.get("volume", 1.0),
        )

    def generate_file(
        self, text: str, output_path: Path, speaker_id: int = None, **kwargs
    ) -> float:
        """
        Generates audio to a file using specific synthesis parameters.
        """
        try:
            config = self._get_config(speaker_id, **kwargs)
            logger.info(f"Synthesizing to file: '{text[:20]}...' with config {config}")

            with wave.open(str(output_path), "wb") as wav_file:
                self.voice.synthesize(text, wav_file, config)

                frames = wav_file.getnframes()
                rate = wav_file.getframerate()
                duration = frames / float(rate)
            return duration
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Error during file synthesis: {e}")
            raise

    def stream(
        self, text: str, speaker_id: int = None, skip_header: bool = False, **kwargs
    ) -> Generator[bytes, None, None]:
        """
        Generates audio as a stream of WAV bytes (Header + PCM Data).
        """
        try:
            config = self._get_config(speaker_id, **kwargs)
            logger.info(f"Streaming synthesis: '{text[:20]}...'")

            # 1. Yield WAV Header (Simulated for streaming)
            if not skip_header:
                sample_rate = self.voice.config.sample_rate
                width = 2  # 16-bit
                channels = 1  # Mono
                yield self._create_wav_header(sample_rate, width, channels)

            # 2. Yield PCM Data Chunks from AudioChunk objects
            # The synthesize() method returns an iterator of AudioChunk
            for audio_chunk in self.voice.synthesize(text, config):
                yield audio_chunk.audio_int16_bytes

        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception(f"Error during streaming synthesis: {e}")
            raise

    def _create_wav_header(self, sample_rate, width, channels):
        buffer = io.BytesIO()
        with wave.open(buffer, "wb") as wav:
            wav.setnchannels(channels)
            wav.setsampwidth(width)
            wav.setframerate(sample_rate)
            wav.writeframes(b"")
        return buffer.getvalue()
```

```python
from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import APIRouter, Request
from fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates

from core.config import settings


router = APIRouter()

_ui_server_root = Path(__file__).parent
_templates_dir = _ui_server_root / "templates"
templates = Jinja2Templates(directory=_templates_dir)


@router.get("/", name="index")
async def index(request: Request):
    """
    Renders the main dashboard.
    Passes API URLs to the template so the frontend knows where to fetch data.
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block content %}
<link href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/themes/prism-coy.min.css" rel="stylesheet" id="prism-theme" />
<style>
    .explorer-container { height: calc(100vh - 140px); overflow: hidden; }
    .pane { overflow-y: auto; height: 100%; border-right: 1px solid #dee2e6; }
    .pane-item { cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #f8f9fa; }
    .pane-item:hover { background-color: #f1f3f5; }
    .pane-item.active { background-color: #e9ecef; border-left: 3px solid #0d6efd; }
</style>

<div class="py-2 border-bottom mb-0">
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-2">
        <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3">
            <h5 class="m-0"><span data-feather="hard-drive"></span> Explorer</h5>

            <div class="btn-group btn-group-sm">
                <input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="ftype" id="t-all" checked onclick="filterType('all')">
                <label class="btn btn-outline-secondary" for="t-all">All</label>
                <input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="ftype" id="t-text" onclick="filterType('text')">
                <label class="btn btn-outline-secondary" for="t-text">Text</label>
                <input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="ftype" id="t-image" onclick="filterType('image')">
                <label class="btn btn-outline-secondary" for="t-image">Images</label>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="btn-group">
            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" onclick="clearCache()">
                <span data-feather="refresh-cw"></span> Reload Repos
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="row g-2">
        <div class="col-md-4">
            <input type="text" class="form-control form-control-sm" id="pathSearch" placeholder="Search filename or path..." onkeyup="handleSearch(event)">
        </div>
        <div class="col-md-2">
            <input type="text" class="form-control form-control-sm" id="extSearch" placeholder="Ext (e.g. .py)" onkeyup="handleSearch(event)">
        </div>
        <div class="col-md-6 d-flex justify-content-end align-items-center gap-2">
            <span class="small text-muted" id="pageInfo">Page 1</span>
            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" onclick="changePage(-1)" id="btnPrev" disabled>&lt;</button>
            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" onclick="changePage(1)" id="btnNext" disabled>&gt;</button>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="row g-0 explorer-container">
    <div class="col-md-2 pane bg-light d-none d-md-block" id="repo-pane">
        <div id="repo-list">
            <div class="text-center p-3"><div class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm"></div></div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="col-md-4 pane" id="file-pane">
        <div class="d-flex justify-content-between p-2 bg-white border-bottom sticky-top">
            <small class="fw-bold text-muted" id="file-list-title">All Files</small>
            <small class="text-muted" id="file-count">0 items</small>
        </div>
        <div id="file-list"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="col-md-6 pane bg-white p-0" id="preview-pane">
        <div id="empty-state" class="h-100 d-flex flex-column align-items-center justify-content-center text-muted">
            <span data-feather="layout" style="width: 48px; height: 48px;"></span>
            <p class="mt-2">Select a file to preview</p>
        </div>
        <div id="content-viewer" class="d-none h-100 d-flex flex-column">
            <div class="p-2 border-bottom bg-light d-flex justify-content-between">
                <span class="fw-bold text-truncate" id="preview-name"></span>
                <span class="badge bg-secondary" id="preview-size"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="position-relative flex-grow-1 overflow-auto bg-light">
                <pre class="m-0 border-0 rounded-0 h-100"><code id="code-block" class="language-plaintext"></code></pre>
                <div id="image-block" class="text-center p-4 d-none h-100 d-flex flex-column align-items-center justify-content-center">
                    <div id="img-container"></div>
                </div>
            </div>
            </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/prism.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/components/prism-python.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/prism/1.29.0/components/prism-json.min.js"></script>

<script>
    const API_BASE = "{{ api_urls.controller }}";

    // State
    let state = {
        scanId: null,
        type: 'all',
        pathQuery: '',
        extQuery: '',
        page: 1,
        limit: 50,
        total: 0
    };

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        loadRepos();
        loadFiles();
    });

    // --- REPO CACHE LOGIC ---
    async function loadRepos() {
        const CACHE_KEY = 'repo_list_cache';
        const container = document.getElementById('repo-list');

        // Try Cache
        const cached = sessionStorage.getItem(CACHE_KEY);
        if (cached) {
            renderRepos(JSON.parse(cached));
        }

        try {
            const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/file/scans`);
            const scans = await res.json();
            sessionStorage.setItem(CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(scans));
            renderRepos(scans);
        } catch(e) {
            if(!cached) container.innerHTML = `<p class="text-danger p-2">${e.message}</p>`;
        }
    }

    function clearCache() {
        sessionStorage.removeItem('repo_list_cache');
        loadRepos();
    }

    function renderRepos(scans) {
        const container = document.getElementById('repo-list');
        container.innerHTML = `<div class="pane-item" onclick="selectRepo(null)">
            <span data-feather="layers"></span> All Scans
        </div>`;

        scans.forEach(s => {
            const name = s.path.split('/').pop() || s.path;
            container.innerHTML += `
                <div class="pane-item" onclick="selectRepo(${s.id}, '${name}')">
                    <span data-feather="package"></span> ${name}
                </div>
            `;
        });
        feather.replace();
    }

    // --- FILE EXPLORER LOGIC ---

    function selectRepo(id, name) {
        state.scanId = id;
        state.page = 1;
        document.getElementById('file-list-title').innerText = name || "All Files";
        loadFiles();
    }

    function filterType(type) {
        state.type = type;
        state.page = 1;
        loadFiles();
    }

    function handleSearch(e) {
        if(e.key === 'Enter') {
            state.pathQuery = document.getElementById('pathSearch').value;
            state.extQuery = document.getElementById('extSearch').value;
            state.page = 1;
            loadFiles();
        }
    }

    function changePage(delta) {
        const newPage = state.page + delta;
        if(newPage > 0) {
            state.page = newPage;
            loadFiles();
        }
    }

    async function loadFiles() {
        const container = document.getElementById('file-list');
        container.innerHTML = '<div class="text-center p-4"><div class="spinner-border"></div></div>';

        let url = `${API_BASE}/file/explorer?page=${state.page}&limit=${state.limit}&file_type=${state.type}&sort_by=modified`;
        if (state.scanId) url += `&scan_id=${state.scanId}`;
        if (state.pathQuery) url += `&path_query=${encodeURIComponent(state.pathQuery)}`;
        if (state.extQuery) url += `&extension=${encodeURIComponent(state.extQuery)}`;

        try {
            const res = await fetch(url);
            const data = await res.json();

            // Handle Paginated Response
            const files = data.items;
            state.total = data.total;

            // Update Pagination UI
            const totalPages = Math.ceil(state.total / state.limit);
            document.getElementById('pageInfo').innerText = `Page ${state.page} of ${totalPages || 1} (${state.total} items)`;
            document.getElementById('btnPrev').disabled = state.page <= 1;
            document.getElementById('btnNext').disabled = state.page >= totalPages;
            document.getElementById('file-count').innerText = `${state.total} items`;

            container.innerHTML = '';
            files.forEach(f => {
                const icon = f.type === 'image' ? 'image' : 'file-text';
                const date = f.modified ? new Date(f.modified * 1000).toLocaleDateString() : '-';

                container.innerHTML += `
                    <div class="pane-item" onclick="viewFile('${f.type}', '${f.id}')">
                        <div class="d-flex align-items-center">
                            <span data-feather="${icon}" class="me-2 text-secondary"></span>
                            <div class="text-truncate" style="max-width: 100%;">
                                <div class="fw-bold text-truncate">${f.name}</div>
                                <div class="small text-muted text-truncate" style="font-size: 0.75rem;">${f.path}</div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="d-flex justify-content-between small text-muted ps-4 mt-1">
                            <span>${(f.size/1024).toFixed(1)} KB</span>
                            <span>${date}</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });
            feather.replace();
        } catch (e) {
            container.innerHTML = `<p class="text-danger p-3">${e.message}</p>`;
        }
    }

    async function viewFile(type, id) {
        // UI Reset
        document.getElementById('empty-state').classList.add('d-none');
        document.getElementById('content-viewer').classList.remove('d-none');
        document.getElementById('preview-name').innerText = "Loading...";

        document.getElementById('code-block').parentElement.classList.add('d-none');
        document.getElementById('image-block').classList.add('d-none');

        // Remove old meta panel
        const existingMeta = document.getElementById('meta-panel');
        if(existingMeta) existingMeta.remove();

        try {
            const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/file/detail/${type}/${id}`);
            const file = await res.json();

            document.getElementById('preview-name').innerText = file.name;
            document.getElementById('preview-size').innerText = `${(file.size/1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;

            // Render Content
            if (type === 'text') {
                const codeEl = document.getElementById('code-block');
                codeEl.textContent = file.content;
                let lang = 'plaintext';
                if (file.name.endsWith('.py')) lang = 'python';
                if (file.name.endsWith('.js')) lang = 'javascript';
                if (file.name.endsWith('.json')) lang = 'json';
                codeEl.className = `language-${lang}`;
                document.getElementById('code-block').parentElement.classList.remove('d-none');
                Prism.highlightElement(codeEl);
            } else if (type === 'image') {
                const imgContainer = document.getElementById('img-container');
                imgContainer.innerHTML = `<img src="data:${file.mime_type};base64,${file.content}" class="img-fluid border shadow-sm">`;
                document.getElementById('image-block').classList.remove('d-none');
            }

            // Render Metadata
            const viewer = document.getElementById('content-viewer');
            const metaPanel = document.createElement('div');
            metaPanel.id = 'meta-panel';
            metaPanel.className = 'p-3 bg-light border-top mt-auto';
            metaPanel.style.fontSize = '0.85rem';

            const exif = file.exif_data || {};
            const exifHtml = Object.keys(exif).length > 0
                ? `<div class="mt-2 pt-2 border-top"><strong>EXIF:</strong> <pre class="mb-0" style="max-height: 100px; overflow: auto;">${JSON.stringify(exif, null, 2)}</pre></div>`
                : '';

            metaPanel.innerHTML = `
                <div class="row">
                    <div class="col-md-6">
                        <strong>Path:</strong> <span class="text-break">${file.path}</span><br>
                        <strong>Type:</strong> ${file.mime_type}
                    </div>
                    <div class="col-md-6">
                        <strong>Stats:</strong> <pre class="mb-0">${JSON.stringify(file.stat_json, null, 2)}</pre>
                    </div>
                </div>
                ${exifHtml}
            `;
            viewer.appendChild(metaPanel);

        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
            document.getElementById('preview-name').innerText = "Error loading file";
        }
    }
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block content %}
<div class="d-flex justify-content-between flex-wrap flex-md-nowrap align-items-center pt-3 pb-2 mb-3 border-bottom">
    <h1 class="h2">Network Hosts</h1>
    <div class="btn-toolbar mb-2 mb-md-0">
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" data-bs-toggle="modal" data-bs-target="#addHostModal">
            + Add Host
        </button>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="table-responsive">
    <table class="table table-striped table-hover" id="hostsTable">
        <thead>
            <tr>
                <th>Hostname</th>
                <th>IP Address</th>
                <th>Device Type</th>
                <th>MAC Address</th>
                <th>Notes</th>
                <th>Actions</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="hostsTableBody">
            <tr>
                <td colspan="6" class="text-center">Loading...</td>
            </tr>
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

<div class="modal fade" id="addHostModal" tabindex="-1" aria-labelledby="addHostModalLabel" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="modal-dialog">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="modal-header">
                <h5 class="modal-title" id="addHostModalLabel">Add New Host</h5>
                <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close"></button>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body">
                <form id="addHostForm">
                    <div class="mb-3">
                        <label for="hostName" class="form-label">Hostname</label>
                        <input type="text" class="form-control" id="hostName" required>
                    </div>
                    <div class="mb-3">
                        <label for="hostIp" class="form-label">IP Address</label>
                        <input type="text" class="form-control" id="hostIp">
                    </div>
                    <div class="mb-3">
                        <label for="hostType" class="form-label">Device Type</label>
                        <input type="text" class="form-control" id="hostType" placeholder="e.g. Router, PC, IoT">
                    </div>
                    <div class="mb-3">
                        <label for="hostMac" class="form-label">MAC Address</label>
                        <input type="text" class="form-control" id="hostMac">
                    </div>
                    <div class="mb-3">
                        <label for="hostNotes" class="form-label">Notes</label>
                        <textarea class="form-control" id="hostNotes" rows="2"></textarea>
                    </div>
                </form>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-footer">
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" data-bs-dismiss="modal">Close</button>
                <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick="submitHost()">Save Host</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    const API_BASE = "{{ api_urls.controller }}";

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadHosts);

    async function loadHosts() {
        const tbody = document.getElementById('hostsTableBody');
        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/host/all`);
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch hosts");

            const hosts = await response.json();
            tbody.innerHTML = '';

            hosts.forEach(host => {
                const row = `
                    <tr>
                        <td><strong>${host.hostname || '-'}</strong></td>
                        <td><code>${host.ip_address || '-'}</code></td>
                        <td>${host.device_type || '-'}</td>
                        <td>${host.mac_address || '-'}</td>
                        <td class="text-muted small">${host.notes || ''}</td>
                        <td>
                            <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-danger" onclick="deleteHost(${host.id})">Delete</button>
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                `;
                tbody.innerHTML += row;
            });

            if (hosts.length === 0) {
                tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-center">No hosts found.</td></tr>';
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error(error);
            tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-center text-danger">Error loading data: ${error.message}</td></tr>`;
        }
    }

    async function submitHost() {
        const data = {
            name: document.getElementById('hostName').value,
            ip_address: document.getElementById('hostIp').value || null,
            device_type: document.getElementById('hostType').value || null,
            mac_address: document.getElementById('hostMac').value || null,
            notes: document.getElementById('hostNotes').value || null
        };

        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/host/`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(data)
            });

            if (response.ok) {
                // Close modal
                const modalEl = document.getElementById('addHostModal');
                const modal = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(modalEl);
                modal.hide();

                // Clear form and reload table
                document.getElementById('addHostForm').reset();
                loadHosts();
            } else {
                alert("Error adding host: " + response.statusText);
            }
        } catch (error) {
            alert("Error: " + error.message);
        }
    }

    async function deleteHost(id) {
        if (!confirm("Are you sure you want to delete this host?")) return;

        try {
            const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/host/`, {
                method: 'DELETE',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ id: id })
            });

            if (response.ok) {
                loadHosts();
            } else {
                alert("Failed to delete host.");
            }
        } catch (error) {
            alert("Error: " + error.message);
        }
    }
</script>
{% endblock %}

```

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block content %}
<div class="d-flex justify-content-between flex-wrap flex-md-nowrap align-items-center pt-3 pb-2 mb-3 border-bottom">
    <h1 class="h2">Image Gallery</h1>
    <div class="btn-toolbar mb-2 mb-md-0">
        <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" onclick="loadImages()">
            <span data-feather="refresh-cw"></span> Refresh
        </button>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="row row-cols-2 row-cols-sm-3 row-cols-md-4 row-cols-lg-6 g-3" id="imageGrid"></div>

<div class="modal fade" id="imageModal" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="modal-dialog modal-xl modal-dialog-centered">
        <div class="modal-content bg-dark text-white">
            <div class="modal-header border-0">
                <h5 class="modal-title text-truncate" id="modalTitle"></h5>
                <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3">
                     <div class="form-check form-switch mb-0">
                        <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" role="switch" id="nsfwSwitch">
                        <label class="form-check-label small" for="nsfwSwitch">NSFW</label>
                    </div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="modal-body p-0 text-center" style="min-height: 60vh; max-height: 85vh; overflow: auto;">
                <img id="modalImage" src="" class="img-fluid" style="max-height: 80vh; object-fit: contain;">
                <div id="modalSpinner" class="spinner-border text-light mt-5" role="status"></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    const API_BASE = "{{ api_urls.controller }}";
    let currentImageId = null;
    let imageModal = null;
    let nsfwSwitch = null;

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        // Init bootstrap objects AFTER DOM is ready
        imageModal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('imageModal'));
        nsfwSwitch = document.getElementById('nsfwSwitch');

        if(nsfwSwitch) {
            nsfwSwitch.addEventListener('change', async (e) => {
                if(!currentImageId) return;
                try {
                    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/file/image/${currentImageId}/toggle-nsfw`, { method: 'POST' });
                    if(res.ok) {
                        loadImages();
                    } else {
                        e.target.checked = !e.target.checked;
                        alert("Failed to update NSFW status");
                    }
                } catch(e) {
                     e.target.checked = !e.target.checked;
                     console.error(e);
                }
            });
        }

        loadImages();
    });

    async function loadImages() {
        const grid = document.getElementById('imageGrid');
        grid.innerHTML = '<div class="col-12 text-center"><div class="spinner-border"></div></div>';

        try {
            const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/file/gallery/images?limit=60`);
            const images = await res.json();
            grid.innerHTML = '';

            images.forEach(img => {
                const src = img.thumbnail || 'https://via.placeholder.com/200x200?text=No+Thumb';
                const date = new Date(img.created_at).toLocaleDateString();
                const nsfwClass = img.is_nsfw ? 'blurred-img' : '';
                const nsfwBadge = img.is_nsfw ? '<span class="badge bg-danger position-absolute top-0 start-0 m-1">NSFW</span>' : '';

                grid.innerHTML += `
                    <div class="col">
                        <div class="card shadow-sm h-100 position-relative" style="cursor: pointer;" onclick="openModal('${img.id}', '${img.name}', ${img.is_nsfw})">
                            ${nsfwBadge}
                            <div style="height: 180px; overflow: hidden;" class="bg-light rounded-top">
                                <img src="${src}" class="card-img-top h-100 w-100 ${nsfwClass}" style="object-fit: cover;" loading="lazy">
                            </div>
                            <div class="card-body p-2">
                                <p class="card-text text-truncate small mb-0" title="${img.name}">${img.name}</p>
                                <small class="text-muted" style="font-size: 0.75rem;">${date}</small>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });
            if(images.length === 0) grid.innerHTML = '<p class="col-12 text-center">No images found.</p>';

        } catch (e) { grid.innerHTML = `<p class="text-danger">${e.message}</p>`; }
    }

    function openModal(id, name, isNsfw) {
        currentImageId = id;
        document.getElementById('modalTitle').innerText = name;
        document.getElementById('modalImage').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('modalSpinner').style.display = 'inline-block';

        if(nsfwSwitch) nsfwSwitch.checked = isNsfw === true; // Ensure boolean

        imageModal.show();

        fetch(`${API_BASE}/file/image/${id}`)
            .then(r => r.json())
            .then(data => {
                 const fullSrc = `data:${data.mime_type};base64,${data.b64_data}`;
                 document.getElementById('modalImage').src = fullSrc;
                 document.getElementById('modalSpinner').style.display = 'none';
                 document.getElementById('modalImage').style.display = 'inline-block';
            })
            .catch(e => console.error("Failed to load full image", e));
    }
</script>

<style>
    .blurred-img { filter: blur(8px); transition: filter 0.3s; }
    .card:hover .blurred-img { filter: blur(2px); }
</style>
{% endblock %}
```
